name: apex-clock
description: Apex Clock — geofenced time clock for warehouse staff

scripts.sync:ios: node scripts/pull-web.js && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync:android: node scripts/pull-web.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run sync:ios && node scripts/prepare-ios.js && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:add: npx cap add ios && node scripts/prepare-ios.js
scripts.android: npm run sync:android && npx cap open android
scripts.build:android: docker build -f Dockerfile.build -t apex-clock-build .. && docker run --rm -e APEX_API_BASE -v "$PWD/dist:/out" apex-clock-build
